_approach: A radio-ready 2022-26 crossover voicing (Cookiee Kawaii 'Vibe', UNIIQU3, and the Ciara 'Level Up' lineage that brought Jersey club to pop charts): the 5-kick skeleton stays but is cleaned up — bigger, simpler clap accents, evenly spaced 8th hats, and fewer competing ghost layers so the pattern sits well under a pop vocal. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
